highlights.excerpt:
Today we’re releasing Muse Spark Open, the most capable US open-weight model to date.

Built for coding and agentic work, it excels at long-horizon tasks, complex software engineering, and multi-step reasoning.

Key Model Specs:
→ 816B total / 42B active parameters
→ 1M token https://t.co/yAtoxNeYJm
highlights.excerpt_zh:
今天我们发布 Muse Spark Open，迄今最强的美国开源权重模型。

专为编程与智能体工作打造，擅长长程任务、复杂软件工程与多步推理。

关键模型规格：
→ 总参数 816B / 活跃 42B
→ 100 万 token
highlights.name: AI at Meta
highlights.text_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Spark Open：美系最强开源权重，816B/42B，面向编程与智能体。

highlights.excerpt:
New voices. Better accents. And less "checking..."

GPT-Live-1.1 brings these updates to Voice in ChatGPT, Codex, and dots, with new voices in French, German, Hindi, Mexican Spanish, Korean, and Japanese.

Rolling out today to all users. Coming soon to the API. https://t.co/L6K8ZUC1xm
highlights.excerpt_zh:
新声音。更好的口音。更少「正在检查…」。

GPT-Live-1.1 把这些更新带到 ChatGPT、Codex 和 dots 的语音功能，并新增法语、德语、印地语、墨西哥西班牙语、韩语和日语声音。

今天起向所有用户推送。API 即将跟进。
highlights.name: OpenAI
highlights.text_zh: OpenAI 上线 GPT-Live-1.1：新语音、更好口音，覆盖 ChatGPT / Codex / dots。

highlights.excerpt:
Applications are now open for two new Anthropic Fellowships.

STEM Fellows (science and engineering) and Conceptual Reasoning Fellows (philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law) will spend four months at Anthropic from January 2027.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
两类新的 Anthropic Fellowship 现已开放申请。

STEM Fellows（科学与工程）与 Conceptual Reasoning Fellows（哲学、认知科学、经济、政策与法律）将于 2027 年 1 月起在 Anthropic 驻留四个月。
highlights.name: Anthropic
highlights.text_zh: Anthropic 开放 STEM / 概念推理 Fellowship，2027 年 1 月驻留四个月。

highlights.excerpt: We want to support the mathematics community in turning progress in AI into deeper human understanding and new discoveries. To support that goal, we are contributing $5 million to a new Simons Foundation initiative to help mathematicians examine, understand, and build on results produced by AI.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 我们希望支持数学界，把 AI 的进展转化为更深的人类理解与新发现。为此，我们向 Simons Foundation 的一项新计划捐赠 500 万美元，帮助数学家检验、理解并在 AI 产出的结果上继续推进。
highlights.name: OpenAI
highlights.text_zh: OpenAI 向 Simons 新计划捐赠 500 万美元，助力数学家检验 AI 成果。

highlights.excerpt:
A few big upgrades for Chrome users today! We’re bringing the power of computer use to anyone who uses Chrome.

First up: ChatGPT can now use your tabs in Chrome to make answers more useful and get things done for you. 

If you’re in Chat, it can look across your open tabs and https://t.co/c99ZSugDcI
highlights.excerpt_zh:
今天给 Chrome 用户带来几项大升级！我们把 computer use 的能力带给每一位 Chrome 用户。

首先：ChatGPT 现在可以用你在 Chrome 里的标签页，让回答更有用，并帮你把事情做完。
highlights.name: ChatGPT
highlights.text_zh: ChatGPT 为 Chrome 带来 computer use：可读开标签、代你完成操作。

highlights.excerpt:
Meet NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL

Our new open model combines reasoning and tool use with text, image, document, and video understanding for long-running AI agents.

120B total parameters with 12B active 🧵 https://t.co/BcbED05qSG
highlights.excerpt_zh:
认识 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL

这款新的开放模型把推理与工具调用，和文本、图像、文档、视频理解结合在一起，面向长时间运行的 AI 智能体。

总参数 120B，活跃 12B
highlights.name: NVIDIA AI
highlights.text_zh: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL：开放多模态，120B/12B，面向长程智能体。

highlights.excerpt:
With Gemini 4 Argon, your research has new ways to tell its story 📖

We used Nano Banana, Veo, and Argon to turn a dense academic PDF into a full-color, animated storybook in the @GeminiApp. https://t.co/GD6teW5IK5
highlights.excerpt_zh:
有了 Gemini 4 Argon，你的研究有了新的讲述方式 📖

我们用 Nano Banana、Veo 和 Argon，把一篇密集的学术 PDF 变成了 @GeminiApp 里的全彩动画故事书。

highlights.excerpt:
We now have state-of-the-art pre-trained base models in the 3T-parameter weight class, built entirely in-house at MAI.

Post-training results coming soon -- stay tuned!

Lots of details in our technical blog post.

https://t.co/K8Nh4YFDJL
highlights.excerpt_zh:
我们现在已有 3T 参数量级的顶尖预训练基座模型，全部在 MAI 内部自研完成。

后训练结果即将公布——敬请期待！

技术博客里有更多细节。
